label: rare: copy-phase input w (fed-back w)
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (~0.009% of steps). 99% of mass is in the copy phase, and 81% of activations/mass occur when the fed-back input token is w (lift 26x); the remainder are mostly copy-phase inputs n or k, plus a couple at <DEL>. It never fires in the original phase on w. However it fires on only ~0.5% of copy-phase w inputs, and no simple condition on output token (2, o, l enriched), position, L, repetition or neighbours recovers precision above ~5%; which w occurrences fire is not captured. Magnitude is weakly higher late in the copy phase/at long L but variation is small (median 0.115, max 0.186).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=w (+6.68), phase=2 & out_tok=2 (+4.21), phase=2 & in_tok=n (+4.18), out_tok=o (+3.55), prev_tok=i (+3.16), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+3.13). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.49), t=7 (-1.47), to_go=6 (-1.20), recall_idx=2 (-1.13).
